question: Does independent literature establish perturbative renormalizability and quantitative one-loop/RG control for the pure 3+1-dimensional projectable Horava gravity parent, while leaving the HMT U(1)+matter completion and full RTK C9 unresolved?

required_sources.required_claim: perturbative renormalizability of projectable Horava gravity; local marginal/relevant gauge-invariant counterterms
full beta functions for marginal essential couplings of 3+1-dimensional projectable Horava gravity
asymptotically free fixed points and trajectories toward a region with GR-form kinetic term

nonclaims: No identification of ordinary projectable Horava gravity with the full HMT local-U(1) RTK candidate.
No beta function is assigned to unresolved HMT physical-matter-interface coefficients.
No full radiative-naturalness closure for RTK is claimed.
No soft-s or k=0.03 production gate is reopened.
